summary: Bench sheets for the Jorvessara JO-6 amorphous dispersion work package ({{PRJ0109:project_id}}). The liquid-vehicle screen is separate from the polymer shortlist. A polymer blend resisted recrystallisation during the stress screen and Jorvessara commissioned a larger drying run; composition and loading remain in the source bench records.

sheets.name: Vehicle screen
rows: Equilibrium solubility and physical stability at the target loading. This liquid-vehicle screen does not measure solid-dispersion recrystallisation.

sheets.name: Polymer loading
rows: Weight percent with its basis stated; refer to the polymer bench sheets for identities, loading and preparation.
Refer to the selected blend recipe card. The liquid-vehicle screen does not identify a polymer blend.
The bench shortlist supports a larger drying run, not a locked process.

sheets.name: Stress screen
rows: A polymer blend resisted recrystallisation during the stress screen.
Refer to the stress-screen bench sheets for conditions, observations and screen suitability entries.
Resistance under the screen conditions does not establish long-term storage stability.

sheets.name: Blend selection
rows: The polymer blend identified in the source recipe card.
